summary: I built the Agents section, the Contact section and the /api/lead endpoint with Supabase. Agents has a header with the copy you specified, three proof points and an interactive "agent run" panel. The panel has scenario tabs (Imobiliária, Clínica, E-commerce, with arrow-key support) and a node graph: the agent core sits in the centre with six tools around it, the active tool lights up and a glowing pulse travels along its curved edge. A timeline trace streams step by step: incoming message, a "pensar" step with a shimmer, tool calls with a spinner then the result and latency, the reply typed with a caret, and a final ✓ card with the elapsed time and outcome chips. It is all scripted and labelled "simulação". It autoplays when scrolled into view, pauses off screen or in a hidden tab, has a replay button, moves on to the next scenario after a pause until the user picks a tab, and shows the finished run under reduced motion. Contact has the huge "Vamos construir / o seu?" headline (outline in lime), a glass form card with the fields you listed, pt-BR inline validation and idle/sending/success/error states, plus a "what happens next" column and the two placeholder buttons. The endpoint validates with zod, accepts both payload shapes, uses a honeypot, a 10 KB body cap and a JSON-only check, and stores leads in Supabase through a server-only service-role client. It degrades as specified when the env vars are missing; the migration, README and .env.example are included.

verified: curl against http://localhost:3000/api/lead (no Supabase env, development): valid site lead → 200 {ok:true, stored:false} (lead logged to the server console); valid demo-imobiliaria lead (single interest) → 200 stored:false; invalid (short name, bad contact, unknown interest) → 422 with fields [name, contact, interests]; unknown source → 422; honeypot filled → 200 {ok:true}; 12 KB body → 413 (also with chunked transfer and no content-length); text/plain → 415; broken JSON → 400; GET → 405

issues: TODO for the owner: 'Falar no WhatsApp' and 'Enviar e-mail' in Contact.tsx have href="#" with TODO comments. The real WhatsApp number (wa.me link) and contact e-mail have not been provided yet. The form's error message also points people to WhatsApp.
Supabase is not configured here, so a real insert (stored:true) and the production 503 not_configured branch were not exercised. Only the dev 'no env' path was tested.
Rate limiting is not implemented. There is a comment in route.ts and a note in supabase/README.md pointing to a Vercel Firewall rule or Upstash.
Reduced-motion behaviour (no autoplay, finished run, instant tab switch, no shimmer or ripple) is coded but not checked in a screenshot, because shot.mjs has no reduced-motion emulation.

lib/supabase/server.ts guards against the browser with a runtime typeof-window throw instead of `import "server-only"`, because that package is not installed (no new dependencies). Adding server-only would give a build-time guarantee.

Shared observation (not changed): with Unbounded, the global `text-outline-acc` / `text-outline` utilities show the font's internal overlapping contours as stray lines inside glyphs (e.g. the 'e' of 'seu'). In Contact I avoided it with fill = bg color + a thicker stroke + `paint-order: stroke fill`. The same fix could go into globals.css for the hero's outlined 'Agentes'.
The agent panel's keyframes (mhb-*) live in a React-hoisted <style> inside my components, since I can't edit globals.css.
I did not view the Instagram reel from the user's request (it is behind a login and not reachable from here). The design follows the mock and docs/design-system.md.
